contract.known_boundary: Normalize battery/power-source state, raw temperature or hardware-sensor telemetry, thermal/compute pressure and throttling signals while preserving unsupported/unknown states.
contract.non_equivalence_policy: Battery level or charging state, raw temperature, power/voltage telemetry, platform thermal pressure, Web CPU pressure and Raspberry Pi throttling flags are related signals but are not semantically interchangeable.

candidates.signal_family: battery level/state and platform power-source / power-save capability
candidates.known_constraint: Battery/power-source telemetry is not equivalent to thermal pressure or raw temperature.

candidates.signal_family: platform thermal status plus battery-temperature stream on supported mobile targets
candidates.known_constraint: Research evidence covers Android and iOS only; no desktop, Web, or Raspberry Pi claim.

candidates.signal_family: hardware sensor temperatures, power and voltage
candidates.known_constraint: Pinned source is discovery evidence only; security preflight blocked on opaque/precompiled artifacts and other high-severity findings.

candidates.signal_family: kernel hwmon/libsensors temperatures, voltage and alarms
candidates.known_constraint: Sensor availability is hardware/driver dependent; Raspberry Pi inclusion is research coverage, not hardware validation.

candidates.signal_family: macOS sensor temperature, voltage and power telemetry
candidates.known_constraint: Research source includes an opaque static library and process-execution tooling, so it is not security admitted.

candidates.signal_family: VideoCore firmware SoC temperature, undervoltage and throttling/capping state
candidates.known_constraint: Pinned branch commit has no supported dependency manifest in the scoped component; runtime/hardware validation remains open.
Package is discontinued and browser/API availability is limited; CPU pressure is not direct temperature.

research_findings.mobile: battery_plus provides battery-state/power-source research while flutter_thermal independently exposes thermal status and temperature on Android/iOS.
research_findings.windows: battery_plus covers battery/power state; LibreHardwareMonitor independently exposes hardware temperature/power/voltage signals, but its pinned source is BLOCKED for security admission.
research_findings.linux: battery_plus uses platform battery integration while lm-sensors uses kernel hwmon/libsensors hardware-monitoring paths. Sensor availability remains hardware/driver dependent.
research_findings.macos: battery_plus covers battery/power state; Stats independently exposes sensor temperature, voltage and power telemetry. Stats remains REVIEW and is not security admitted.
research_findings.web: battery_plus supplies Web battery research while js_bindings exposes Compute Pressure PressureObserver/PressureState. The latter is discontinued and CPU pressure must not be represented as a direct temperature measurement.
research_findings.raspberry_pi: lm-sensors represents Linux hwmon/kernel sensor discovery while official raspberrypi/utils vcgencmd exposes firmware-side measure_temp and get_throttled signals. They are mechanically distinct, but no Raspberry Pi hardware validation has been performed.
research_findings.security: Only flutter_thermal reached a complete CLEAR preflight. battery_plus is REVIEW because Pub dependency versions were unresolved for vulnerability scanning; other platform-specific sources are REVIEW or BLOCKED as recorded in the live evidence.

decision.next_action: Keep discovery depth closed but admission open: replace or isolate BLOCKED/REVIEW sources where possible, define normalized unavailable/unknown and pressure/temperature semantics, complete security/vulnerability gates, then run target-specific runtime and Raspberry Pi hardware tests.
